sentences.en: The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few.
sentences.zh: 多数人的需求比少数人的需求更重要。

sentences.en: The risks of such a project would clearly outweigh any putative benefit.
sentences.zh: 此类项目的风险显然会超过任何可能的好处。

sentences.en: A mother's advice would outweigh a friend's.
sentences.zh: 母亲的建议胜过朋友的意见。

senses.zh: 在重量上超过,比…重要,胜过，强过,比…有价值

mnemonic: 词根记忆：out（超过）+weigh（称重）→比…重要
